subject.title: fix(heartbeat): suppress Conversation info block for synthetic heartbeat turns

question: Should maintainers adopt this PR after a caller-boundary refactor, or prefer the sibling caller-owned fix path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97072?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same heartbeat metadata bug, this branch is conflicting, and the best permanent owner boundary is a maintainer code-shape choice rather than a label-only cleanup decision.

options.title: Prefer caller-boundary fix
options.body: Use the caller-owned `isHeartbeat`/typed synthetic-turn path, require real heartbeat proof, and land only one canonical PR for the linked issue.

options.title: Adopt this branch after refactor
options.body: Keep this contributor branch as the landing vehicle only if it is rebased and changed to avoid provider-string policy inside the shared metadata helper.

options.title: Pause duplicate branch
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged while maintainers advance the sibling fix or a maintainer replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Prefer caller-boundary fix
recommendation.body: Use the caller-owned `isHeartbeat`/typed synthetic-turn path, require real heartbeat proof, and land only one canonical PR for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent heartbeat scheduler history makes this the best available owner for the canonical-fix choice.
